eligibility.quote: The position limits for `joint_s`, `joint_r` and `joint_t` are specified as `(-)3.1416` for the SIA20 in [sia20d_macro.xacro](https://github.com/ros-industrial/motoman/blob/e2384f02d926da5b9716fdf915783af31962138c/motoman_sia20d_support/urdf/sia20d_macro.xacro), which is incorrect

failed_conditions.quote: It would appear the values in the urdf are _rounded up_, while they should'be been either _floored_ or written out with more digits.

loudness.quote: MoveIt exploited the tiny bit of extra space, while the robot (correctly) returned an error, refusing to complete the motion.

notes: URDF joint limits for SIA20 rounded up pi to 3.1416 causing planner to plan motions out-of-bounds for the physical controller.
